summary: The documents describe methods and functions related to generating HTML elements and handling new windows in a .NET application called HSPnet.
purpose: To provide reusable functions for generating HTML content and managing new window interactions within the HSPnet application.

workflows.name: New Window Details
steps: Call the newWindowDetails method with required parameters like session, request ID, role, etc.
Generate a link with parameters formatted for a new window interaction.
Add a URL hash to the link for security.
Return the modified link with URL hash appended.

workflows.name: Disable Element
steps: Call the disableElement function with the HTML element to be disabled.
Wrap the element in a span with a CSS class 'disabledtext'.

workflows.name: Translate New Lines
steps: Call the translateNewLines function with the input text.
Check if the text is null or empty, and if so, return an empty string.

Replace carriage return and new line characters with HTML
tags.
